members.title: Members
members.singleUser: Member management is not available in single-user mode.
members.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage members.
members.oidcReadOnly: Users are provisioned automatically on first sign-in through your identity provider. This list is read-only.
members.loadError: Could not load members. You may not have admin permission, or the server is unreachable.
members.inviteDescription: A single-use invite URL will be created. Share it with the person you want to add. They'll choose their own username and password when they redeem it.
members.inviteUrlDescription: Send this URL to the new member. It expires in {{ttl}} and is single-use — once they redeem it, it can't be used again. This URL is shown only once.
members.newPasswordDescription: Send this password to the user out-of-band (e.g. Slack DM). It is shown only once.
members.removeDescription: This deletes the user account and revokes all their session permissions. Sessions they own become inaccessible unless another user has manage rights on them. This action cannot be undone.

policies.title: Global Policies
policies.description: Global policies applied to all sessions.
policies.noPermission: You don't have permission to manage global policies.
policies.addDescription: Choose a policy to apply globally to all sessions.
policies.name: name
policies.empty: No global policies configured. Add one to apply it to all sessions.
policies.removeDescription: This removes the global policy from all sessions. Existing session-level policies with the same handler are unaffected.
